title: Testing integration — discipline
description: Prompt discipline: run the suite after changes, report failures verbatim.
heading: TESTING
body:
- After any code change, run the project's test suite before handing off.
- Report failing tests verbatim — do not paraphrase failures.
- Never mark work complete with a red suite unless the human explicitly accepts it.

title: Testing integration — post-edit reminder hook
description: PostToolUse reminder hook: nudges to run tests after Edit/Write.
command: echo '[taskflow:testing] source changed — run the test suite before handoff'

title: Testing integration — run-tests skill
description: Skill that runs the project's test command and reports results verbatim.
name: taskflow-run-tests
content:
---
name: taskflow-run-tests
description: Run the project's test suite and report results verbatim
---

Run the project's configured test command (see `taskflow.config.json.agents.extend` or the project README — insight-flow ships no default). Report the summary line and every failing test verbatim. Do not paraphrase or truncate failure output. If no test command is configured, say so and stop.
